tools.name: search_foods
tools.description:
Searches USDA FoodData Central by food name.

Each match has an fdc_id, its dataset, key macros per 100 g, and, for
branded products, USDA's verbatim ingredient statement.
ingredients_available is false when USDA supplied no ingredient statement
for that record. Results are paged, and pagination.nex

tools.name: get_food_nutrition
tools.description:
Returns the nutrient breakdown for one food at a serving weight.

The result has macros, micronutrients, an assessment against daily
targets, USDA's verbatim ingredient statement when available, and common
portion sizes with their gram weights. ingredients_available is false when
USDA supplied no in

tools.name: compare_foods
tools.description:
Puts several foods side by side at the same serving weight.

highest_per_nutrient names the food with the most of each nutrient.
failed lists ids that could not be loaded, and partial is true when the
comparison is missing some of them.

tools.name: analyze_meal
tools.description:
Totals nutrients across several foods and assesses the meal.

assessment.shortfalls lists missed targets, worst first, and
assessment.over_limit lists exceeded limits. not_reported lists nutrients
with no data in the food records; those are unknown, not zero. failed
lists items left out of the total

tools.name: find_foods_by_nutrient
tools.description:
Ranks foods by how much of one nutrient they carry per 100 g.

The default list is lab-measured foods. Branded products are included only
when data_type is Branded. Amounts that cannot fit in 100 g, and potassium
above the potassium-chloride ceiling, are left out. Per-100 g ranking
favors foods eate

tools.name: database_status
tools.description:
Reports whether the local USDA database is built and what it holds.

The result counts foods by dataset and records with an ingredient statement.

tools.name: list_retailers
prepare_retailer_handoff
tools.description:
Packages exact retailer products into links for the user to open.

The handoff repeats the products, links, and quantities with the original
request. It does not contact the retailer, change a cart, or check out.

tools.name: resolve_ingredients
tools.description:
Matches ingredient names to FoodData Central foods and converts portions to grams.

Portions such as 2 tbsp, 1/2 cup, or 1 medium are converted with each
food's own measured portions, so 1 cup differs for spinach and olive oil.
Repeated ingredients are looked up once. method says how each portion wa

tools.name: analyze_recipe
tools.description:
Totals one dish from its ingredient list and reports it per serving.

Ingredient quantities are for the whole dish, as a recipe states them.
per_serving divides by servings, whole_recipe holds the undivided totals,
and the assessment covers one serving.

tools.name: analyze_plan
tools.description:
Analyzes a multi-day meal plan and assesses its daily average.

Every ingredient is resolved and converted, then totaled by dish, meal,
and day, up to 400 ingredients. The assessment is of the daily average, not
the multi-day sum. per_day has each day's totals, shopping_list totals

tools.name: set_profile
tools.description:
Stores a profile for this conversation so assessments use Dietary Reference Intakes.

Age- and sex-specific U.S. Dietary Reference Intakes replace the generic
food-label values. The result lists the resolved daily targets and limits.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description:
Returns this conversation's profile and the daily targets it resolves to.

profile is null when none is set, and assessments then use the FDA
food-label daily values.

tools.name: clear_profile
tools.description:
Deletes this conversation's profile so assessments use the FDA food-label values.

cleared is false when no profile was set.
